en.title: Ergonomic Slippers – Thick-Soled for Indoors & Outdoors
en.descriptionHtml:
Tired feet after a day at home? Then you've got the wrong slippers.

Thin, flat slippers work against you – every step lands hard on your heels and knees. You won't notice straight away. You'll notice by evening.

The solution: like walking on clouds

A thick, shock-absorbing sole that cushions every step and takes the strain off your joints and back. Cosy indoors – and non-slip enough for the patio and garden.

Features

  • Thick ergonomic sole with shock absorption
  • Non-slip – indoors and outdoors
  • Light and breathable – dries quickly
  • Unisex in multiple sizes
  • Perfect for home, patio and holiday cottage

Our guarantee

30-day satisfaction guarantee – if you're not happy with them, you'll get your money back. Fast delivery and secure payment with Klarna. 🦫
